en: Colorized vintage view of a riverside or lakeside promenade in a landscaped park. On the left stands a villa‑like building covered in ivy with a terrace café, white picket fence, and red‑and‑yellow sun umbrellas. Behind it rises a small round turret with a conical roof topped by flags. Large trees line the path. On the right, people including children lean on a metal railing overlooking calm water with small boats. Low hills and forested countryside appear in the hazy background. No visible title or printed text appears on the image side.
